titolo: Anthropic launches reporting suite to track enterprise AI token spend
descr: New tools let companies see cost, output and workflow bottlenecks of Anthropic models like Claude Code.
paragrafi: Anthropic announced a suite of reporting tools aimed at enterprise customers.
The tools let managers view team work over chosen dates, output produced, token cost and workflow breakdowns.
Anthropic says the data will not be used for model training by default and will include recommendations for improvement.
Anthropic also introduced pooled group budgets to help teams manage token spending more effectively.
perche: For users of free or locally run models, the focus on enterprise analytics highlights a gap in transparency tools available for open‑source alternatives.
